note: Fifth consistent telling of the same split: Senate lost, House barely held.
Two months on he is still working out what his own image means, and says so. The skier reading is his own guess, offered as a guess.
Third date given for the same State of the Union: the 25th on 15 January, the 3rd on 27 January, the 24th or 25th here. The Olympic opening is now correct at the 6th.
Marked as what he believes rather than what he saw.
Adds the fact checkers as the mechanism and a European same-day event as the trigger. He hedges the fulfilment himself with not exactly sure, which is worth crediting.
The two options he offers are that it unfolds or that prayer stopped it, which between them exhaust the outcomes.
Sits against rapture-not-2026 and microwave-jesus-2028 from the same season, where he pushes specific dates further out while here calling later-not-sooner a mistake.
Adds the consequence, impeachment in 2027 or 2028. But this version has both chambers lost where the settled telling has the House held, so the detail and the claim do not quite agree.
Fourth on-air replay of an original recording, with the dates located from the archive rather than from memory.
The bringing them home language points at aliyah. Recorded with the money request attached, because the appeal to sow into it is part of the claim as given.
Seventh restatement of the plague timing. 2027 and 2028 again.
The repetition is offered as the evidence, and something major is the widest content available. Filed empty so that if it is ever specified the empty version is on file first.
Belongs with visions-while-driving as an account of when and how the material arrives.

A flat negative call, which is rare: he will not run and will not make it. That sits against the same claim's earlier telling, where the appetite for the office was the point and a run was assumed. Framed as a declaration rather than a sight, so a run could be read as insufficient prayer.
